jobs.employer_name: Produktions- und Ressourcenöko landwirtschaftlicher Betriebe der TU München
jobs.description: The Professorship of Environmental Economics at the Technical University of Munich (TUM), CampusWeihenstephan, invites applications for a PhD position in Economics within the research project WETTER (Water Efficiency through Technology, Targeting, and Experimental Research), funded by the Joachim Herz Prize 2026. The position is expected to start in February 2027. The appointment is initially for 36 months, with the possibility of extension. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate interested in conducting large-scale field experiments (RCTs) at the intersection of behavioral and environmental economics, with a particular focus on sustainable household behavior.About UsThe Technical University of Munich (TUM) is one of Europe’s leading research universities and a longstanding member of Germany’s Excellence Initiative. With its strong interdisciplinary research environment and close collaboration with industry and policy institutions, TUM provides an outstanding setting for academic research. The TUM School of Management consistently ranks among the leading business schools in Europe.What We Offer• An excellent research environment at one of Europe’s leading universities• Salary according to the German public sector pay scale (TV-L E13, 75%)• The opportunity to work on a large-scale, policy-relevant research project• No teaching obligations, but teaching opportunities are available• Funding for research activities, conference participation, and doctoral training• Close academic supervision, mentoring, and regular feedback• Integration into the doctoral program of the TUM School of Management(https://www.mgt.tum.de/de/faculty-research/doctoral-program)Requirements• Master's degree in economics or a related discipline with very good results• Strong background in econometrics, causal inference, and empirical research methods• Experience in managing, processing, and analyzing large-scale datasets using R, Python or Stata• Fluency in spoken and written EnglishApplicationPlease submit your application documents in a single PDF file (including a one-page cover letter outliningyour experience and research interests, a CV, and academic transcripts) to sebastian.tonke@tum.de withthe subject line “PHD WETTER”. In addition, one letter of recommendation should be sent directly by theletter writer to the same email address. The application deadline is 15th November 2026. Only shortlistedcandidates will be contacted.Equal OpportunityAs part of the Excellence Initiative of the German federal and state governments, TUM has been pursuingthe strategic goal of substantially increasing the diversity of its staff. As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, TUM explicitly encourages nominations of and applications from women as well as from all others who would bring additional diversity dimensions to the university’s research and teaching strategies. Preference will be given to candidates with disabilities with essentially the same qualifications.Data Protection NoticeAs part of your application, you provide personal data to the Technical University of Munich. Please view our privacy policy on collecting and processing personal data in the course of the application process pursuant to Art. 13 of the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union (GDPR) at https://portal.mytum.de/kompass/datenschutz/Bewerbung/. By submitting your application, you confirm to have read and understood the data protection information provided by TUM.Ergänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte PersonenHomeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: We are looking for an (Senior) Analyst to join our Transactions Team in Berlin. In this hands-on investment role, you will support acquisitions, disposals, and joint ventures across office, hotel, residential/BTR, logistics, and development assets. Working closely with Senior Transaction Managers and the Co-Head of Transactions, you will be involved in underwriting, financial modelling, due diligence, transaction execution, and investment analysis across Germany and selected international markets. Location: Berlin Your Tasks Transaction Execution & Management Support the full deal lifecycle on acquisitions and disposals across Germany and international markets, covering office, hotel, residential, logistics, and development assets. Prepare financial models, DCF analyses, and business plans for standing assets and development projects; stress-test assumptions and evaluate investment scenarios. Drafting or assisting with drafting and review Letters of Intent (LOIs), term sheets, and other transaction documents. Coordinate and manage due diligence workstreams, including data room management, adviser coordination, and cross-departmental communication. Support signing and closing management, including CP tracking and condition satisfaction. Investment Analysis & Underwriting Screen, evaluate, and underwrite incoming acquisition opportunities across target asset classes and geographies. Prepare investment memoranda, board presentations, and transaction approval documents that clearly communicate financial metrics, investment thesis, and risk/return profile. Develop and maintain financial models (excel-based) for both stabilised assets and value-add / development opportunities; produce Key Metric Summaries. Conduct in-depth feasibility analysis for repositioning, conversion, and development scenarios. Market Research & Deal Origination Conduct comprehensive market research on target real estate sub-markets, including supply/demand dynamics, rental trends, yield movements, and competitive landscape. Build and maintain deal flow tracking tools and acquisition pipeline databases (CRM). (Support) Deal-sourcing efforts through broker engagement, market intelligence, and investment screening. Participate in meetings with brokers, institutional investors, JV partners, and other stakeholders. Your Profile Education & Experience Degree in Business Administration, Real Estate Management, Finance, Economics, or Engineering; MRICS / master's-level qualification a plus. At least two years of professional experience in real estate investment, private equity (real estate), M&A, asset management, valuation, or brokerage. Track record of financial modelling and investment analysis across European real estate markets; experience with development projects is an advantage. Technical Skills Advanced Excel skills, including dynamic financial models, DCF / IRR analysis, and scenario modelling -- proficiency is non-negotiable. Strong PowerPoint skills; ability to produce clear, concise investment presentations and board materials. Hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g. large language models, AI-assisted research, prompt engineering) and/or CRM / deal management platforms is a strong advantage. Familiarity with data room platforms (e.g. Drooms, Intralinks, Datasite) is a plus. Competencies & Personal Profile Strong quantitative and analytical thinking -- able to cut through complexity and build conviction on investment cases. Self-starter with high initiative, ownership mentality, and the ability to manage multiple work streams simultaneously in a fast-paced deal environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills -- ability to present financial analysis and investment logic concisely to senior stakeholders. Meticulous attention to detail, reliability, and a strong sense of accountability. Collaborative team player with a growth mindset and an appetite for continuous learning. Languages: Excellent English (written and spoken) required; fluent German is a strong plus and highly preferred for the German market.
